content: max_ai's Agent is built around a pluggable reasoning loop (ReactLoop by default): it calls the model, executes any proposed tool calls, folds the results back into the transcript, and repeats until a tool-free answer passes the CompletionGate.

Every tool declares an approval_mode: AUTO_APPROVED runs immediately, ASK_APPROVED pauses the turn for a human y/n decision before it executes. A rejected tool now pauses the whole turn (finish_reason=tool_denied) instead of letting the model keep acting on a broken assumption.

CompletionGate decides whether a proposed final answer can close the turn. RuntimeCompletionGate (always registered) checks plan closure and declared Bash deliverables; domain-specific gates can add their own rules, sync or async (e.g. an LLM-judge).

Loop guards (SchemaRetryGuard, RepetitionGuard, BudgetGuard) run after each tool round and can steer the model with a transient message — never written to the durable transcript — to correct classic small-model failure modes like repeating an identical tool call.

Memory (CoreMemoryRegistry) stores session-scoped categories the agent can read, create, update or delete. search_memory looks across the same user's OTHER sessions by meaning, without copying results into the current session.

Knowledge sources (CoreKnowledgeRegistry) expose a search_{name} tool per source, backed by local embedding cosine similarity over a JSON file of content blocks. Ingestion (chunking, writing that file) happens externally — the registry is read-only from the agent's side.

Skills are self-contained packages (a SKILL.md plus optional scripts/references) the agent discovers through a lightweight name+description catalog in the system prompt, and reads in full only when it decides a task actually needs one.
